## Objective

Implement the smallest complete Customer Privacy runtime and adjudication boundary that enforces active legal hold before mandatory retention before an approved privacy action, without beginning owner execution.

## Deliverables

- `promote customer_privacy.legal_hold.place@1.0.0 through existing generic ingress`
- `prove current canonical Party and acquire the shared tenant-plus-Party lock before legal-hold placement`
- `strictly load bounded active legal holds from FORCE-RLS storage under the same lock`
- `evaluate immutable plan items with precedence active legal hold then mandatory retention then approved privacy action`
- `persist exact authority, reason, policy, review and final-action evidence without owner side effects`
- `prove clean PostgreSQL, rollback/reapply, replay, cross-tenant and real crm-api behavior`

## Acceptance

- legal-hold placement is activation-gated, live-authorized, tenant-bound, idempotent and atomic
- active matching legal hold overrides mandatory retention and approved action
- mandatory immutable or minimized evidence overrides a destructive approved action
- unmatched destroyable or rebuildable evidence retains the approved action
- unavailable, malformed, over-bound, stale or cross-tenant hold state fails closed
- no owner mutation, deletion, anonymization, export, outcome write or worker is introduced
- no public contract, manifest, generic router algorithm, dependency family, Cargo.lock or workspace package is changed

## Explicit non-goals

- legal-hold release or public legal-hold reads
- restriction release or public restriction reads
- owner action dispatch or outcome persistence
- access or portability export assembly
- delete, anonymize, crypto-shred or tombstone behavior
- Customer Privacy workers
- crate consolidation or dependency upgrades
